 Africa Cup of Nations Qualification
 Live: Morocco vs. Niger | AFCON 2027 Qualifiers
 Morocco host Niger on Matchday 3 of the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations Qualifiers. The Atlas Lions will look to maintain their perfect record and strengthen their lead at the top of Group A against a team desperate for points to remain in contention for qualification.
 Don't miss the match between Morocco and Niger on beIN SPORTS. 
 Morocco Look to Maintain Their Perfect Record
 The Atlas Lions return home with a clear mission: secure their third consecutive victory and take another step toward the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations .
 The team managed by Mohamed Ouahbi have made a flawless start to the qualifiers, recording 2-0 victories over Gabon and Lesotho .
 With six points, four goals scored, and none conceded, Morocco sit at the top of Group A and will look to maintain their dominance in front of their home supporters in Casablanca.
 The match also represents another opportunity for Ouahbi to continue developing his project, combining the experience of his established stars with a new generation of young players beginning to make their mark.
 Among the team's key figures are Achraf Hakimi , Brahim Díaz , Yassine Bounou , and Noussair Mazraoui , players who remain essential to the Atlas Lions' competitiveness.
 En-Nesyri Returns as Morocco Introduce New Faces
 One of the biggest developments in the squad is the return of Youssef En-Nesyri , who is once again available to strengthen Morocco's attack.
 The striker brings international experience, a strong presence inside the penalty area, and an important attacking option for Mohamed Ouahbi's system.
 Another notable addition is Ayoub Oufkir , the AZ Alkmaar winger who has received his first senior international call-up and will have the opportunity to showcase his talent.
 In attack, Morocco can also rely on Abdessamad Ezzalzouli , Yassir Zabiri , and Yassine Gessime , while Ayyoub Bouaddi , Neil El Aynaoui , and Bilal El Khannouss provide different options in midfield.
 The depth of the squad will be one of Morocco's biggest strengths as they pursue another victory.
 Niger Aim to Surprise the Atlas Lions
 On the other side, Niger remain firmly in the race for qualification.
 The team coached by Nabil Neghiz began their campaign with a 2-1 victory over Lesotho , thanks to goals from Daniel Sosah and Oumar Sako .
 However, they subsequently suffered a 2-0 defeat against Gabon , leaving them third in Group A with three points.
 For this doubleheader, Neghiz selected a 25-man squad, including nine players from the domestic league.
 Among Niger's key players are Rahim Alhassane , who plays for Bologna , alongside Ali Mohamed , Daniel Sosah , and Oumar Sako .
 The challenge will be particularly difficult considering the recent history between the two nations.
 Morocco defeated Niger 2-1 in March 2025 before recording an emphatic 5-0 victory in September of the same year during the 2026 FIFA World Cup Qualifiers .
 The two teams will also meet again on November 17 in Rabat.
 Although Niger will officially be the home team for that second encounter, the match will also take place on Moroccan soil because Niger currently do not have a stadium approved to host the competition.
 Don't miss the match between Morocco and Niger on beIN SPORTS. 
 The match between Morocco and Niger will take place on Friday, November 13, at Stade Mohammed V in Casablanca.
 Match Facts
 Match: Morocco vs. Niger
 Competition: 2027 Africa Cup of Nations Qualifiers
 Matchday: 3 – Group A
 Date: Friday, November 13, 2026
 Stadium: Stade Mohammed V, Casablanca, Morocco
 Key Takeaways From Morocco vs. Niger
 Morocco lead Group A with six points, two victories, and no goals conceded in the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations Qualifiers .
 Youssef En-Nesyri returns to the squad, while Ayoub Oufkir receives his first senior international call-up.
 Niger enter the match with three points and will look to surprise the Atlas Lions before facing them again on November 17 in Rabat.
